description: Dhaka (Bangladesh) - Informal Settlements (ESA EO4SD-Urban) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Probable informal settlements over Dhaka (Bangladesh) contains spatial explicit information about position of slums as identified in 2006 & 2010 from ancillary data sources and in 2017 by interpretation of VHR satellite imagery. The level of detail for the classification scheme mainly relies on the input data sources. Coverage: Bangladesh. It has 4 files in SHP ZIP, HTML, PDF. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
